loops.note: The orthography loop. Loop 5's critics found the corpus right and its SPELLING wrong, so the fix went to the source: `∥` and the optional-syllable marks are deleted rather than turned into spaces (帮忙 is bāngmáng, not bāng máng — 192 headwords fixed), CC-CEDICT's neutral-tone digit is honoured (学生 xuésheng), and all 4,308 example sentences are now set as sentences — word boundaries off the shipped corpus, a capital, a terminal stop, and the 479 commas that used to be thrown away. Alongside it: Discard is armed like Reset so one tap on the quiet control cannot erase the only copy, a new word is asked its first question inside the session that introduced it, the app bar docks to the run's column instead of the window, and the mobile browse header is two rows instead of three.

Nine critics, nine FAILs — the loop the app stopped being judged on whether the feature exists and started being judged on whether it is right. Two were data losses under a finger: Restore now proves it restored before deleting the only copy, and a build gate forbids two cards sharing a sentence or a translation. The rest were spelling and layout: pinyin set as words rather than spaced syllables at all 16 call sites, a production prompt rebuilt like the teach card, preview glosses set as one wrapped line, and a focus shell with a definite height so the quiz control is never below the fold.
